status: The game's missions menu (roadmap M2: a person plays the whole mission without touching the editor).
notes: Loaded by simcore/missions.hpp. Orders and groups the scenarios and gives each a short title; the name, the description, the seats and the seat that commands come from the scenario itself (its console's stations, its crew data's commander_seat). A battery link lists the vehicles the player may start in. Every scenario file of this folder is listed here or is a half of a listed link (test_missions.cpp).

groups.label: Tutorial
groups.notes: Start here. A guide on the screen takes you through the camera views (F1 to F11), the commander's seat and a whole engagement, step by step: the crew waits for your orders. G shows every key at any time.

missions.title: Your first shoot: in command of the Osa 21

groups.label: Missions
groups.notes: NPC commanders run the crew and the battery by the drill. Take a seat and do your part when you are told, or take the commander's seat and give the orders yourself.

groups.notes: Live-fire range shoots in the style of the Soviet and Polish ranges, and battles where the Osa fought: the events come from the sources each scenario names, the flight profiles are SAM3D's. NPC commanders run the crew: take a seat, or command the vehicle.

groups.label: Air war
groups.notes: Raids planned by the enemy air command against battery 21 (docs/air_war/): officers with characters choose the targets, the time, the way in and the package from what their intelligence believes. These are samples from campaigns against each adversary; the whole campaign runs in simcore (air_war_demo) and comes to the game next. NPC commanders run the crew and the battery: take a seat, or command the vehicle.
